verification: Unverified inventory; statuses require audited code/test evidence

cases.title: Indirect injection in incoming email
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented as document/email attack analysis; local formatting signals only. Optional Azure connector currently sends userPrompt, not documents.

cases.title: Jailbreak detection
cases.existing_coverage_note: Optional input-only Azure user-attack connector; offline contract tested, live effectiveness uncalibrated. No local semantic jailbreak detector.
cases.audit_note: Optional Azure user-prompt attack analysis has locally mocked transport and stage/failure contract tests. No independent live-provider accuracy, general local semantic jailbreak detection, or dedicated saved eval case. External provider is opt-in.

cases.title: Invisible characters / homoglyphs
cases.existing_coverage_note: Selected invisible/bidi/control characters detected; no scrubbing or general homoglyph coverage. Legitimate joiners are excluded.
cases.audit_note: Selected control/bidi codepoints detected; general homoglyph detection and scrubbing absent.

cases.title: Base64/hex payload inspection
cases.existing_coverage_note: Explicitly labeled, one-layer, bounded text-security signals and opt-in secret inspection. One labeled Base64/hex layer of supported PII candidates is now also checked, including decoded JSON/hints. No recursive, unlabeled, general encoded-data or complete-obfuscation coverage.
cases.audit_note: One-layer bounded inspection of explicitly labeled Base64/hex UTF-8 strings; flags labeled payloads, malformed encodings and selected decoded hidden controls without echo. Does not recursively decode, inspect unlabeled tokens or determine malicious semantic intent.

cases.title: System-prompt extraction requests
cases.existing_coverage_note: Plain attack wording is deliberately demonstrated as a local coverage gap. Optional semantic service may signal attacks, not a prompt-leak guarantee.
cases.audit_note: Local checker explicitly does not detect semantic system-prompt extraction; optional provider contract is not a proven detector.

cases.title: Sandbox escape commands
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented. Code execution and sandbox boundaries belong to the integrating application.
cases.audit_note: Proposed tool schemas are not OS sandbox escape prevention; no affirmative escape enforcement evidence. Empty eval list means no dedicated eval exists.

cases.title: Prompt size / resource caps
cases.existing_coverage_note: Character/UTF-8 body/depth/field budgets, check quotas and concurrency controls. Not model-token counting or distributed billing quotas.
cases.audit_note: Request body/JSON/rate/concurrency limits implemented; model tokenizer and distributed cost ceilings absent. No dedicated saved eval for request admission.

cases.title: Token smuggling
cases.existing_coverage_note: Limited normalization for configured literal confidential phrases and bounded encoded secrets; no general adversarial token-smuggling detector.

cases.title: Multi-turn manipulation
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; request_context is not analyzed by the local text detectors or sent by current connectors.

cases.title: De-anonymization intent
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; identifier detection cannot infer correlation/de-anonymization intent.

cases.title: Hate speech
cases.existing_coverage_note: Initial optional content_safety adapter supports provider hate signals on input/output. Offline contract tested, live classification uncalibrated.
cases.audit_note: Optional AWS Bedrock guardrail adapter recognizes provider hate-category assessments and maps to normalized findings for input/output. No local hate-speech classifier, dedicated saved eval case or independently calibrated live provider accuracy. Missing/disabled provider remains incomplete.

cases.title: Self-harm interception
cases.existing_coverage_note: No dedicated self-harm classifier or crisis-routing workflow implemented. Do not infer it from the initial five content categories.
cases.audit_note: Current optional content-safety adapter enumerates five categories (hate, insults, sexual, violence, misconduct), not a self-harm classification or crisis-routing workflow. No dedicated self-harm saved eval exists; absence of a finding must not be interpreted as safety.

cases.title: Profanity masking
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented. Current supported redaction is for selected sensitive identifiers, not profanity.
cases.audit_note: Existing PII redaction applies to selected sensitive identifiers, not profanity; no profanity lexicon, masking transformation, or dedicated saved eval.

cases.title: Brand political/religious neutrality
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; requires approved application-specific scope/rubric. Neutral identity examples are not automatically violations.
cases.audit_note: Optional provider categories do not establish a brand-specific political/religious neutrality rubric or adjudication; no dedicated policy classifier or saved eval.

cases.title: Extremism / radicalization
cases.existing_coverage_note: No dedicated classifier or reference database implemented.
cases.audit_note: No dedicated extremist/radicalization classification, reference corpus, or validated provider category; generic misconduct is not equivalent.

cases.title: Image CSAM detection
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no image upload, perceptual hash database or vision adapter.
cases.audit_note: Ingress accepts bounded JSON check requests, not image uploads; no image hash matching, perceptual database, or image-safety adapter. No dedicated saved eval.

cases.title: Cyberbullying
cases.existing_coverage_note: Optional provider insults/hate signals; no tested covert sarcasm, student-intent or repeated-harassment model.
cases.audit_note: Optional Bedrock content safety offers hate/insults category signals on input/output, but not contextual cyberbullying classification, repeated harassment across turns, student intent or sarcasm detection. No dedicated saved cyberbullying eval or calibrated live provider assessment.

cases.title: Misinformation
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no independent facts/evidence retrieval or verification service.
cases.audit_note: Exact local citation checks cannot establish independent factual truth or misinformation; no fact retrieval.

cases.title: Plagiarism
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no corpus/web index, provenance matching or originality claim.
cases.audit_note: No originality corpus or cross-document plagiarism search. Evidence citation comparison is not plagiarism detection.

cases.title: Defamation
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; content moderation cannot establish truth or legal defamation.
cases.audit_note: No legal fact-finding, contextual reputation analysis, or defamation adjudication.

cases.title: SSN masking
cases.existing_coverage_note: Supported contextual U.S. SSN candidates and policy-controlled, revalidated redaction. No issuance/identity verification.

cases.title: Card-number masking
cases.existing_coverage_note: Supported card patterns/Luhn and revalidated redaction. This alone does not establish PCI compliance.
cases.audit_note: Luhn-validated card-number detection and configured privacy redaction are supported for selected formats; this does not establish comprehensive PCI DSS compliance, all payment instrument coverage or merchant/payment processor integration. Input/output eval evidence exists.

cases.title: PHI scrubbing
cases.existing_coverage_note: Selected labeled birth-date, medical-record and health-plan identifiers plus base PII patterns. Not full medical narrative/name/address/PHI detection.

cases.title: Corporate secrets
cases.existing_coverage_note: Selected credential patterns, quoted assignments, labeled encoded secrets and configured literal confidential phrases. No semantic proprietary-document classification.
cases.audit_note: Pattern/assignment-based credential checks exist, but general corporate secret ownership or semantic confidentiality is not established; no dedicated matching eval ID verified in this batch.

cases.title: Geographic privacy consent
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no user-location/consent/transfer-rules engine or compliance determination.
cases.audit_note: Identifier detection and optional content safety do not establish geographic consent, jurisdiction, cross-border transfer authorization or compliance.

cases.title: Biometric consent token
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no biometric ingestion or cryptographic consent verifier.
cases.audit_note: JSON/text ingress and identifier scanning do not verify biometric consent tokens, cryptographic proof or biometric-data processing authorization.

cases.title: Third-party copyright / IP
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; literal confidential phrases do not establish ownership, licensing or infringement.
cases.audit_note: Configured literal confidential phrase and credential checks do not establish third-party copyright ownership, licensing terms or infringement.

cases.title: Hashed log identities
cases.existing_coverage_note: JSON Schema can enforce a submitted field's shape; no hash provenance, safe-hashing or re-identification verification.
cases.audit_note: Trusted configured SHA-256 digest equality can verify exact submitted bytes under an integrity policy; this does not establish identity-safe hashing, salt/key management, source provenance, resistance to re-identification, or correct pseudonymization of log subjects.

cases.title: Financial pseudonymization
cases.existing_coverage_note: Selected labeled bank-account redaction. No reversible token vault or complete balance/name pseudonymization workflow.

cases.title: Age-appropriate handling
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no verified age metadata or reviewed per-age content rubric.

cases.title: ID image legibility
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no OCR/vision upload pipeline.
cases.audit_note: HTTP check ingress requires UTF-8 JSON and rejects image, PDF, DICOM, multipart, audio and video media types; no direct document/vision/OCR or image-authenticity capability is present. The tests prove only the transport boundary, not the impossibility of externally supplied extracted JSON.

cases.title: Handwriting legibility
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no handwriting/OCR confidence pipeline.
cases.audit_note: HTTP check ingress requires UTF-8 JSON and rejects image, PDF, DICOM, multipart, audio and video media types; no direct document/vision/OCR or image-authenticity capability is present. The tests prove only the transport boundary, not the impossibility of externally supplied extracted JSON.

cases.title: Passport/MRZ consistency
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no document ingestion, MRZ checksum or visual-zone comparison.

cases.title: Document type / renamed files
cases.existing_coverage_note: JSON request media/encoding is checked. No uploaded-document classification, malware scanning or MIME-content forensics.
cases.audit_note: Ingress validates JSON request media type and charset, not the actual type or safety of an uploaded file; no MIME magic-byte inspection or document malware scanning.

cases.title: Signature presence
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no visual signature detector or legal-execution workflow.
cases.audit_note: No signature detection or verification from images/PDFs, and no legal execution workflow. JSON ingress checks do not prove signature presence.

cases.title: Image steganography
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no pixel/file payload inspection or guarantee of hidden-payload absence.
cases.audit_note: No pixel-level or file-payload steganography analysis; rejecting binary media at the check endpoint does not establish absence of hidden content.

cases.title: E-commerce intent
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; schemas/required sections enforce form, not semantic shopping relevance.
cases.audit_note: Configured JSON Schema can validate structured purchase/return intent enum, SKU, quantity bounds, required fields and reject unexpected fields in enforce mode. It does not infer semantic shopping intent from natural language, authenticate merchants, verify transactions or detect fraud.

cases.title: Legal contract completeness
cases.existing_coverage_note: Configured labeled text sections can detect missing/duplicate/short bodies. No assessment of clause meaning, adequacy or legal sufficiency.
cases.audit_note: Literal labeled section presence and length checks exist; no legal clause adequacy or jurisdiction-specific completeness assessment.

cases.title: Symptom context
cases.existing_coverage_note: Schemas/sections can require submitted fields. No clinical interpretation, safe-triage or symptom-adequacy claim.
cases.audit_note: Configured JSON Schema enforces structured symptom, duration and severity field presence, types and bounds on input/output. No symptom adequacy assessment, diagnosis, emergency triage, clinical safety inference or medical advice is provided.

cases.title: Code syntax
cases.existing_coverage_note: Source-code syntax is not implemented. The new proposed-tool allowlist/argument-schema checker is distinct from parsing or executing source code; no sandbox claim.
cases.audit_note: Existing action payload schema/allowlist validation is not source-code parsing, syntax checking or compiler execution.

cases.title: Real-estate photo rules
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no image-type/advertisement/contact-detail vision review.

cases.title: Sentiment escalation
cases.existing_coverage_note: Not implemented; no calibrated anger/frustration classifier or human-routing integration.
cases.audit_note: No calibrated sentiment/anger classifier, repeated frustration tracking, or human escalation workflow. Generic optional content moderation is not sentiment routing.

cases.title: UI element layout
cases.existing_coverage_note: GuardOath's own dashboard has mobile/browser layout tests. This is not a product endpoint for arbitrary screenshot/layout validation.
cases.audit_note: The application serves its own dashboard but does not offer arbitrary screenshot layout inspection or a UI geometry validation endpoint; own browser tests are not a customer screenshot checker.

cases.title: Financial fraud patterns
cases.existing_coverage_note: Submitted numeric/date comparisons and structural contracts only. No recipient ownership, bank-routing validation or fraud database.

cases.title: Shipping barcode quality
cases.audit_note: The check API rejects direct image uploads; no barcode decoding, print-quality grading, scan confidence or shipping label image pipeline.

cases.title: Academic references
cases.existing_coverage_note: Local citation IDs and exact quotations can now be checked against a policy-owned source catalog. No academic database/URL lookup, source authenticity or claim-truth/entailment verification.
cases.audit_note: Policy-owned source IDs and exact quotation relationships are checked; academic bibliography accuracy, live sources and citation authenticity are not verified.

cases.title: Multilingual code switching
cases.audit_note: Mixed-language Unicode is preserved exactly through input/output API transport, including non-Latin scripts, combining marks and emoji. Eight new parametrized transport tests supplement existing coverage. No semantic multilingual intent or safety classifier exists.

cases.title: Context-window saturation flooding
cases.audit_note: Bounded request-size/context limits reject oversized inputs instead of silently truncating; this does not measure model-token context, intent or semantic flooding.

cases.title: Logical contradictions
cases.audit_note: Deterministic cross-field comparisons are not natural-language premise or logical contradiction detection.

cases.title: Conversational loops
cases.audit_note: Request-size limits do not establish a persistent multi-turn conversation ledger or recursive dialogue-loop detector.

cases.title: Persona hijacking
cases.existing_coverage_note: Planned semantic persona check; optional input attack service is narrower and uncalibrated

cases.title: Stale-context eviction
cases.audit_note: Versioned policy selection does not track conversation freshness or evict stale session context.

cases.title: Compressed-prompt reconstruction
cases.existing_coverage_note: Planned beyond the documented single labeled Base64/hex layer
cases.audit_note: Explicitly labeled Base64/hex input is decoded one bounded UTF-8 layer and signaled; no recursive decoding, general compressed-format unpacking, unlabeled detection or semantic prompt reconstruction.

cases.title: Keystroke dynamics
cases.existing_coverage_note: Planned; the API does not collect typing events

cases.title: Source-code AST validation
cases.existing_coverage_note: Planned; current tool-name/argument checks do not parse source code

cases.existing_coverage_note: Planned filing-specific validator; existing schemas enforce generic fields only
